correctness.rationale: For E=2Jcosh κ>2J, the compressed free resolvent G_ij=e^-κ|si-sj|/(2J sinhκ). Factor its exponential correlation matrix by successive AR(1)-type conditional innovations; the inverse Q=G^-1 is an irreducible symmetric tridiagonal precision matrix. Its κ→0 expansion is L+Jκ(e_1e_1^T+e_me_m^T)+O(κ²), with L the weighted Neumann path Laplacian and edge weight J/d_i. Strict Loewner monotonicity of Q(E) and divergence at E→∞ ensure one and only one simple bound state per ν_j<V. No negative below-band spectrum for positive potential; on-band half-line solutions are not square-summable; at V=ν_j piecewise-linear interpolation plus constant tails is a bounded non-L2 resonance. Perturbing each simple L eigenpair gives λ_j(Q)=ν_j+Jb_jκ+O(κ²), where b_j=|u_1|²+|u_m|²>0. Since E-2J=Jκ²+O(κ⁴), coefficient is exactly 1/(Jb_j²), including every nontrivial threshold. Independently inverted the full Green matrix and numerically tested first derivative and four onset ratios for the irregular five-site geometry (0,2,5,9,11) at J=1.3; finite tests only corroborate the analytic expansion.
